title: Cogent DataHub Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Cogent DataHub. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the GetPermissions.asp component of the web server. This active server page is vulnerable to command injection which allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the context of the DataHub process.
